summary: Full backend + frontend E2E for UX-polish iteration. Backend pytest: 28/28 PASS including new tests for demo seed (>=8 open demo shifts), welcome chat auto-seeded on accept (mentions accepter's first name), enriched workspace docs (shift_price/currency/owner_id/accepted_by), simulated pay flow that returns receipt held_in_escrow + double-payment rejected (400) + GET /receipt works, and pay-then-complete releases funds + increments earner wallet_balance by shift.price. Frontend E2E: homepage manifesto intact; fresh signup as seeker lands on /dashboard; OnboardingChecklist (data-testid=onboarding-checklist) with all 6 numbered steps visible; dismiss hides + persists via localStorage sc_onboarding_dismissed=1; /shifts on fresh account shows demo titles (Golden-hour, SAT Math, Product photography, system design, Godox); accept flow opens workspace with welcome chat mentioning the accepter's first name; Payment tab renders 4-stage escrow tracker (Posted/Accepted/Held/Released) + big $ amount hero + StatusPill; pay-btn opens PaymentModal, form pre-fills 4242…/12/28/123, submit → payment-processing → payment-success with receipt rows (Receipt id, Amount, Method Visa ••••4242, Status Held in escrow) → payment-done closes; after payment, header/tab shows complete-btn; complete opens CompletionModal (rate-1..5 + review-text + submit-review-modal) then celebration-done. No console errors on happy path.

ui_bugs.issue: When backend returns a pydantic validation error (422 with FastAPI detail=[{...}]), the signup form displays '[object Object]' instead of a readable message. Repro: try signing up with a '.test' TLD email (which is what the problem statement asked us to use, e.g. polish+{ts}@sc.test) → backend returns 422 → UI renders '[object Object]'. Fix: normalize error extraction in AuthPages.jsx / api.js to stringify FastAPI validation payloads (detail array → first msg).

integration_issues.issue: Backend pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD as reserved (email-validator library). The problem statement explicitly instructs using 'polish+{ts}@sc.test' — this returns 422. Workaround used: 'polish+{ts}@sctest.io'. Not a regression from prior iteration (same behavior), but the E2E instructions won't work as-written on any tester copy-pasting the exact email pattern. Fix option: switch EmailStr to a permissive validator or drop .test entirely from prod docs.

issues: When payment_status='pending', stage 3 'PAYMENT HELD IN ESCROW' is highlighted/pulsing (via active: pending) while the header StatusPill correctly shows 'AWAITING PAYMENT'. Visually the tracker leaps to the next-step preview instead of showing stage 2 as the current stage — creates cognitive dissonance with the pill. Consider marking stage 2 (Accepted) as active-current until payment is made.

action_items: Fix signup error rendering to unwrap FastAPI 422 detail array (currently shows '[object Object]').
Either accept .test TLD server-side or update the problem statement/docs to use a real-looking TLD (e.g. sctest.io).
Optional: rework the escrow tracker's 'active' logic so the current stage (not the next stage) is highlighted.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx PaymentTab escrow stages: `active: ws.payment_status === 'pending'` on the 'held' stage means the tracker previews the NEXT step as active instead of marking the current stage — potentially confusing.

api.js request wrapper likely throws the raw JSON error object; AuthPages.jsx catches with `e.message` which becomes '[object Object]' when detail is an array. Add helper: `errMsg(e) => Array.isArray(e.detail) ? e.detail[0].msg : (e.message || String(e))`.
server.py has grown to 800 lines with DEMO_USERS + DEMO_SHIFTS + seed_demo inlined — consider extracting to seed.py.
seed_demo() gate `existing >= len(DEMO_USERS)` skips seeding shifts if users already exist but shifts were deleted — currently OK because inner shift check also gates on count==0. Good.
PaymentTab computes stages inline every render — fine for now but could memoize.

CompletionModal fetches otherUser from Workspace state; if participants array is stale (e.g. same user id repeated due to bad seed), review submit hits `Cannot review yourself` 400 and throws uncaught. Add graceful UI error toast.
No size limit on file upload (base64 stored in Mongo) — noted in prev iteration, still open.
